select 'discovery_cycle' k, max(started_at)::text v from incentive_discovery_cycles
union all select 'programs_last_seen', max(last_seen_at)::text from incentive_programs
union all select 'book_events_last', max(received_at)::text from incentive_book_events where id > (select max(id)-1000 from incentive_book_events)
union all select 'evo_heartbeat_last', max(at)::text from evo_heartbeats
union all select 'now', now()::text
